name: Jinko Tiger Neo 430W
notes: Jinko's TOPCon flagship, spanning an unusually wide 430W to 630W across four different cell counts (108, 120, 132 and 144 half-cell). The 630W top bin is the standout: its 132-cell layout pushes Isc to 16.2A, the highest current in this file, and needs a 30A series fuse against 25A for every other bin in the series - check MPPT current headroom carefully before selecting it. The 430-440W bins are the standard 108-cell entry point with the lowest Voc, useful for longer strings.
